id./param/scenario/cs/b_060_cs_030.pack|cs_: "...What? Staring at me. Is something on my face?
"I see. You don't like my appearance.
"Hm, not this one either? Then how about this!
"Hm. Seeing my form won't settle, you don't know who I am.
"...In your world, I am called the Seer.
"Each person imagines me differently, so my form changes to suit the beholder.
"...By the way, have you caught anything?
"When fish bite, they bite. You must endure until the proper time comes. That is key.
"...Come to think of it, I feel I've met one of your companions. Erik, I think.
"Well, no matter. I'll return to my room. Ho ho ho."
